nieuw.titel: Support early aggression with movement spells
nieuw.tekst: For an early-aggression plan with a combat-focused army, consider Steed of Shadows or Arcane Urgency to accelerate the advance.
nieuw.waarom: He says double marching or giving an infantry unit flight provides a huge movement advantage, particularly with Drilled.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says these spells help but are not always essential to making the plan work.

nieuw.titel: Accept calculated shooting risks to reach combat
nieuw.tekst: When your combat-focused army needs to fight to win, accept a calculated shooting risk as you advance. Judge the likely casualties rather than treating every exposed approach as unacceptable.
nieuw.waarom: He accepts the risk because he does not expect to win this game unless he gets into combat.
nieuw.voorbeeld: He advanced his Chosen Chaos Knights directly in front of a Dwarf cannon after assessing its likely damage and their saves. He lost one model on the approach and charged the cannon next turn.

nieuw.titel: Take an imperfect target to escape shooting
nieuw.tekst: In an early-aggression plan, consider charging a shooting threat even if it is not your attacker's ideal target. Getting into combat can protect the attacker from further shooting while removing a threat to it.
nieuw.waarom: He values getting his knights into combat where they cannot be shot, while removing a weapon that can kill them.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Chosen Chaos Knights charged a cannon. He acknowledged that it might not be their prime target but considered the protection from shooting and removal of the threat worthwhile.

aanvullingen.voorbeeld: Against Dwarfs with substantial shooting, he marched his combat army forward to set up charges on his next turn. His knights reached the cannon, his Marauder Horsemen reached the Organ Gun, and two units flank-charged the Longbeards.
aanvullingen.toelichting: The same recommendation to cross the board quickly and shut down enemy shooting before it weakens the combat army.
